consolidated_findings.title: Items-board KDSOrderItemsResource does NOT expose allergens_snapshot — chef batched-prep view is allergen-blind
consolidated_findings.source: RED-team P0 challenge + Architect cross-verification + confirmed by passing KDSAllergenVisibilityTest covering CARDS view (/api/admin/kds-order) only

evidence.split_by_allergen_in_service: app/Services/KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:298-319 (groupBy hashes allergens but rendered output discards them)
evidence.test_coverage_gap: tests/Feature/Orders/KDSAllergenVisibilityTest.php asserts CARDS view only — no test for /api/admin/kds-order/items items-board endpoint

consolidated_findings.rationale_severity: Downgraded P0 → P1: cards-view (primary chef interface) exposes allergens correctly. Items-board (secondary batched-prep panel) is allergen-blind. Owner-gated severity escalation if items-board UI is used for allergen-sensitive batched prep.

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.test_addition: Add tests/Feature/Kds/KdsItemsBoardAllergenExposureTest.php asserting /api/admin/kds-order/items returns allergens_snapshot per item

consolidated_findings.title: Recall + bump mechanism is browser-local localStorage with NO backend persistence, NO audit trail, NO cross-station coherence

evidence.frontend_localstorage_only: resources/js/store/modules/kds.js:1,55-85 (STORAGE_BUMPED key; bumpItem persistMap; recallItem persistMap)
evidence.no_backend_route: routes/api.php:1005-1011 (only index/changeStatus/items/sync routes exist — no /bump and no /recall endpoints)
evidence.no_axios_in_kds_store: Grep on kds.js confirms zero axios/fetch/window.api calls
evidence.owner_intent_gap: i18n key fr.json:1176 'kds_recall_grace_expired' = 'Rappel impossible : délai d'annulation (60 s) dépassé' — suggests an undo of a finalized status, NOT a per-item per-browser revert

impact: Cross-browser inconsistency: chef A bumps item, chef B (same station) cannot see bump state
Cache-clear / private browsing wipes ALL bump history mid-shift
No fiscal/operational audit log for bump events
No cross-station handoff: tablet stations cannot share readiness state
60s grace window enforced by Date.now() locally — clock skew untracked

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.patch_size: moderate — new migration + new endpoints + Vuex action refactor
scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.change: Backend endpoint POST /kds-order/{order}/items/{item}/bump and POST /kds-order/{order}/items/{item}/recall persisting to new kds_item_events append-only table; broadcast on existing per-branch channel; localStorage becomes write-through cache
scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.risk: medium — touches Vue component (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue not in frozen list but contains 2670 LOC; carefully scope changes to kdsBump/kdsRecall handlers only)

consolidated_findings.frozen_zone_touch: PARTIAL — public/js/admin-kds.js is dirty (do NOT touch), but Vue source component is touchable per scope

consolidated_findings.title: GDPR data minimization — customer.name shipped on ALL KDS payloads (not minimized like customer.phone was)

evidence.historic_precedent: Comment at lines 62-66 documents [Sprint 5A Z9-P0-03] GDPR minimization for phone (delivery-only). Same principle should apply to name.

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.change: Wrap customer.name in delivery/dine-in conditional similar to phone: 'name' => in_array((int) $this->order_type, [OrderType::DELIVERY, OrderType::DINE_IN], true) ? $this->user->name : null

consolidated_findings.title: POST /kds-order/change-status has NO rate-limit middleware — insider DoS vector via flood of compromised Chef token

evidence.comparison_other_routes: routes/api.php:1016-1018 client-metrics has throttle:60,1; outbox/retry-failed has throttle:10,1 — pattern exists across the codebase

consolidated_findings.impact: Insider attack (compromised chef token) can hammer lockForUpdate() exhausting MySQL connection pool. Even without compromise, a chef accidentally double-clicking 100x/min generates 100x audit_log [KDS_409] entries.

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.change: Add ->middleware('throttle:60,1') to the change-status route declaration
scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.risk: very-low (60 req/min is generous for a single chef workflow)

consolidated_findings.title: KDS orderItems() query has no LIMIT 50 (unlike list()) and no Redis cache (unlike sync) — admin-global path returns potentially unbounded payload

evidence.code_excerpt: $orders = $query->where(...)->get(); — no ->limit() chain; list() at line 150 uses ->limit(51) for overflow detection
evidence.no_cache: Unlike KdsSyncService::sync() at line 49 which uses Cache::remember 5s TTL, orderItems() hits DB every call

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.change: Add ->limit(50) to orderItems() query; wrap in Cache::remember(2s) similar to sync() pattern; surface overflow flag in controller meta

consolidated_findings.title: POST /kds-order/change-status lacks X-Idempotency-Key middleware — duplicate retry causes audit log double-entry

evidence.missing_middleware: IdempotencyKeyMiddleware not applied; expected_status optimistic lock catches duplicate transition but Mail/SMS/Push dispatches and [KDS_409] log entry still fire on the second attempt

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.risk: low (matches existing pattern on POS/Order routes per CLAUDE.md §9)

consolidated_findings.title: KDS bump localStorage shared across operators (no user_id namespace) on a station

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.change: STORAGE_BUMPED = `kds.bumped_items_v1.${userId}.${branchId}` — read auth from window.AUTH or Vuex
scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.supersede_by_Z1_P1_02: If Z1-P1-02 (backend persistence) is healed first, this finding becomes moot

consolidated_findings.title: No observability counter for OrderStatusChanged broadcast failures — silent degradation possible

evidence.code_excerpt: Log::warning('[KDS] OrderStatusChanged broadcast failed: ' . $e->getMessage()); — no metric increment

scope_minimal_heal_recommendation.change: On catch, increment observability counter (e.g. via SyncMetricsRecorder pattern) and surface in /admin/observability/sync-overview

consolidated_findings.title: KdsSyncService computeOrderVersion TODO: planned status_changed_at column not yet implemented

evidence.code_excerpt: TODO(F-03 / Phase 3 dette technique D-03bis): when the planned `status_changed_at` column lands on Order

consolidated_findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Document deferred to V1.0.3 (low-occurrence edge case)

consolidated_findings.title: Side-effect dispatch (Mail/SMS/Push) fires before broadcast — recoverable via polling fallback but races possible

evidence.self_gating_verified: OrderMailNotificationBuilder::message at line 46-66 self-gates per-status — so RED P1 was overstated; downgrade to P3

consolidated_findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Re-order: broadcast first (non-blocking), Mail/SMS/Push after broadcast confirmed

consolidated_findings.title: Order.token field exposed in KDSOrderDetailsResource — semantic verified as internal (table-order pickup key, not customer-shared QR)

evidence.verification: app/Services/OrderService.php:2061-2073 tokenCreate() sets order->token from TableOrderTokenRequest (internal table-order routing). Not a customer-shared secret.

consolidated_findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Defer — informational. Document that order.token is internal scoped to table-order routing.

nf525_chain_impact: NONE — all findings are operational, not fiscal. Audit_logs chain integrity unaffected.

test_existing_coverage.verdict: PASS — no regression from baseline; 77 tests cover the audited surface

Branch isolation + transition whitelist + tz-aware + sargable queries PASS. 77/77 KDS tests pass. Heal deferred to V1.0.2/V1.0.3 backlog tickets.
